import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

plan = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_round3_batch_plan.json').read_text())
path = Path('results/training/qwen38_round3_batch.json')
assert not path.exists(), 'Inspect the existing submission receipt before restarting; never submit twice'
metadata = json.loads(Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_train/kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
assert metadata['is_private'] and metadata['kernel_type'] == 'script'
source = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_train') / metadata['code_file']
assert file_sha256(source) == plan['source_sha256']
env = {**os.environ, 'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR': str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for key in ('KAGGLE_KEY', 'KAGGLE_API_TOKEN', 'KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'):
    env.pop(key, None)
python = '/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python'
reset = datetime.fromisoformat(plan['gpu_window_start'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'launch the exact private saved batch after verified new quota'}, plan['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'plan_sha256': file_sha256('results/training/qwen38_round3_batch_plan.json'),
          'metadata': metadata, 'source_sha256': file_sha256(source),
          'status': 'waiting_for_reset', 'polls': [], 'quota_checks': []}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
while time.time() < reset.timestamp():
    time.sleep(min(60, reset.timestamp() - time.time()))
subprocess.run([python, 'runs/refresh_kaggle_access.py'], env=env, check=True)
while True:
    subprocess.run([python, 'scripts/kaggle_quota.py'], env=env, check=True)
    snapshot = json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text())
    quota = snapshot['quota']
    available = quota['gpu_seconds_total'] - quota['gpu_seconds_used'] - quota['gpu_seconds_reserved']
    record['quota_checks'].append(snapshot)
    record.update(status='checking_refreshed_quota', available_seconds=available)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    if datetime.fromisoformat(quota['refresh_at']) > reset and available >= 63000:
        break
    time.sleep(610)
assert file_sha256(source) == plan['source_sha256'], 'Prepared source changed while waiting'
record.update(status='submitting', submitted_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
result = subprocess.run(plan['training_command'], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
record['push'] = {'command': plan['training_command'], 'exit_code': result.returncode,
                  'output': result.stdout, 'error': result.stderr}
match = re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)', result.stdout)
record.update(status='submitted' if result.returncode == 0 and match else 'push_requires_inspection',
              version=int(match[1]) if match else None)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
assert record['status'] == 'submitted', 'Inspect the push result; do not retry an ambiguous submission'
ledger_path = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel': metadata['id'], 'version': record['version'],
    'accelerator': 'T4 x2 requested', 'start': None, 'end': None, 'hours': None,
    'submitted_at': record['submitted_at'], 'purpose': 'Round 3 saved batch: full registered Qwen3.8-27B SFT then GRPO96, with optimizer checkpoints.',
    'private': True, 'status': 'submitted', 'source_commit': plan['source_commit'],
    'receipt': str(path), 'session_timeout_seconds': 41400,
    'hours_basis': 'Pending downloaded runtime and official account debit; the cap is not measured usage.'})
ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Submitted private saved batch version', record['version'], flush=True)
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python', '-u', 'scripts/watch_kaggle.py', '--receipt', str(path),
                '--out', f"results/kaggle/qwen38-round3-training-v{record['version']}"], check=True)
